dst.baseline: Prior-season plus current-season-to-date DST fantasy points allowed/produced with leakage-safe decay.
dst.touchdown_rule: Count only touchdowns whose scoring team is the defense or return/special-teams team and is not the offensive possession team. Do not infer missing touchdown attribution as zero unless the source field is present and resolved.

kicker.baseline: Prior-season plus current-season-to-date team-kicker fantasy points with leakage-safe decay.
kicker.identity_rule: Historical calibration may use the team kicker slot to avoid falsely carrying a departed kicker across seasons. Current 2026 player identity is attached only after verified roster/depth-chart reconciliation.

walk_forward.parameter_selection_rule: For each held-out season, tune all decay and regularization only on earlier seasons; the held-out season cannot select its own parameters.

requirements: rich model improves MAE and RMSE in every held-out season
pooled MAE improves over the simple baseline
all scoring components are source-covered rather than imputed
no sportsbook or ADP feature contamination

shared_state_rule: DST and kicker consume the same canonical football state used by fantasy/game/prop engines. A football effect may not be applied once in team scoring context and again as an independent DST/K adjustment without explicit decomposition.
missing_data_rule: Missing source fields remain unknown. Missing defensive/special-teams touchdowns, kick distance, weather or roster identity may not be silently converted to zero.
next_step_after_validation: 6.5D spread/total game model upgrade using the same canonical football state.
